text.what: Letting whatever came in on the fruit and lives in the cellar start the ferment, instead of pitching a selected strain from a packet.
text.how: The early work is done by non-Saccharomyces species that die off as alcohol rises; Saccharomyces cerevisiae finishes. The risk is a stuck ferment or a population you did not want; the argument for it is the character those first days leave behind.

kin.as: What ends a cold soak, if nobody intervenes.
The organism that gets blamed when this goes wrong.
